description: Déraciné (CUSA11919) gameplay, reached headlessly: emulated PSVR, no OpenXR host and no physical headset, from savedata slot 1 (stage m00_00_10_10) via the M2 scripted Move sequence. Measurement is the emulator's own unique-rendered-frame series (frame stats), not the compositor.

measured_2026_11_18.source: M2/M3 headless runs (m2-off-fixed-1, m3-portable-2) and the unified-build live cell recorded in _build/team/INTEGRATION-HANDOFF-headless.md; the user's handover

menu_disambiguation.note: The menu/front end is ~465-500 draws and ~480 Mpx and cannot pass either the 800-draw gate or the 1500-draw band; a run that never leaves it is reported phase=menu, never as gameplay.

band_rationale: Draws per frame is the stable discriminator for this title's gameplay (1866-1900 vs 465-500 in the menu). Mpx and passes depend on the renderer state: the candidate renderer measured 550-720 Mpx / 38-46 passes, the unified renderer 860 Mpx / 55.7 passes at the same scene. Bounding draws tightly and Mpx/passes loosely accepts both without accepting the menu or the loading dip, and the large per-frame area change remains visible in the report. Re-derive this band only with a fresh live cell, never from a projection.

save.note: Slot 1 makes Continue load the classroom; the quality-lab save (slot 0, m00_00_80_10) stays on the menu forever. The three files are pinned by sha256; they are game/user data and are not committed.

input.note: The script is the M2 confirm sweep: it aims the mirrored Move hand at Continue and presses it. All of it is test-only and off unless these variables are set.

image_reference_note: No gameplay eye reference is installed. A candidate exists (_build/headless/validation/evidence/gameplay-reference-candidate/gameplay-eye-m2-confirm-1.png, menu-vs-gameplay SSIM 0.4174) but it was never visually reviewed and installed. Until it is, scene identity rests on the numeric gate+band, which the menu cannot satisfy; an optional reference can be added here and checked by scene_signature.py. Separately, colour correctness must be claimed only through image_validation.py (RGB), never through scene similarity.

reproducibility.note: M2 gameplay entry has been reproduced in two independently constructed labs: m2-off-fixed-1 (gate 64 s, 1866.3 draws / 606.2 Mpx / 41.4 passes) and m3-portable-2 (gate 63 s, 1865.8 / 550.2 / 38.4, gameplay capture visually checked). The unified build also reached the same scene (1866.3 draws, 860 Mpx / 55.7 passes); that confirms the scene but is not a benchmark cell under the pre-M2 band. Any A/B/A numbers still need matched-scene cells.
